gripOrHq.title: Vacuum Link
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Shock.r
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

gripOrHq.title: Roving Submarine
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

heapOrArchives.title: ACME Savings and Loan
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. For the remainder of the game, pay [1] at the end of each of your turns, or lose the game. You can remove this effect, and score 1 agenda point, by taking an action to pay [12].

discardCards.title: Private LDL Access
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: HQ Interface
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

discardCards.title: R&D Interface
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

discardCards.title: Executive Wiretaps
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

2 credits: +1 strength.
